entries.EN:
The Laugo Alien pistol is a revolutionary firearm known for its innovative design and exceptional performance. Featuring a low bore axis and a unique gas pedal-style grip, the Alien offers reduced muzzle rise and improved control, allowing for quick and accurate follow-up shots. Its sleek profile and futuristic appearance make it stand out among other handguns, while its precision engineering and top-notch materials ensure reliability and durability. Nobody knows why it is in the zone of all places or how Nimble even managed to get his hands on one, and even less have even thought about purchasing it, for no stalker would dare spend this much on a 9mm pistol.

entries.EN:
The Colt Python is a legendary double-action revolver introduced in 1955, renowned for its precision and power. Known as the "Rolls-Royce of revolvers," it features a full underlug barrel for stability and reduced muzzle flip, typically chambered in .357 Magnum. Its sleek design, ventilated rib, and hand-finished craftsmanship make it exceptionally accurate and aesthetically appealing. Favored by law enforcement and enthusiasts alike, the Colt Python is celebrated for its smooth trigger pull and outstanding accuracy.

Originally designed for the American market, the USP, Universal Self Loading Pistol, is known as an accurate and reliable handgun. U.S. law enforcement and military provided much of the design criteria for the USP. The controls are uniquely American, influenced by famous designs like the Government Model 1911 pistol. The HS2000 is a Croatian-made pistol, manufactured by HS Produkt. It has a polymer frame and fires based on a Striker, which is similar to the Glock pistols.
